script:
Nanny Jia (Jewelry Merchant's Wife)
Nanny Jia is the wife of jewelry merchant Zhen Shang, but she's not content with her lot and often flirts with Yao Qianshu, the pawn shop owner in town. She met Yao Qianshu at a wine party three years ago. At that time, Yao Qianshu was in high spirits at the party and spent money very generously. Nanny Jia felt he was much better than the miser Zhen Shang at home.
Nanny Jia is the town gossip - she knows about everything that happens. For instance, not long after she met Yao Qianshu, she heard that a house in town caught fire and a woman inside was burned alive. She also knew that Yao Qianshu's wife Sister Wang wasn't a good person either, often going to bars late at night and messing around with men. Two years ago, she heard that a wealthy family had moved to town and immediately bought a villa. Having nothing to do, Nanny Jia went to inquire and just happened to hear that the family wanted a nanny, so she agreed. But when she first entered the house, she discovered that the lady of the house was actually Chen Hongdeng, a bar girl from the town tavern. She told the master Li Changqing about this, but found that he already knew. The master told her that her name was now Li Meimei and promised to give her hush money every month, which finally made Nanny Jia keep quiet.
During her work, Nanny Jia discovered that Chen Hongdeng, now Li Meimei, was mentally unstable. Li Changqing seemed afraid she would cause trouble outside and often locked her in the house. Nanny Jia usually didn't provoke her. The master wasn't normal either - he had no job but lots of money, and half his face was covered in burn scars, very terrifying.
One day, while cleaning Li Changqing's things, Nanny Jia saw an appraisal report with a photo of a blue diamond valued at a hundred million yuan. Faced with such money, Nanny Jia could keep her mouth shut, knowing that such matters could bring trouble, so she didn't dare speak carelessly.
One day, while Nanny Jia was secretly meeting with Yao Qianshu, Yao Qianshu suddenly showed her a bag of gems, telling her that each gem was worth several million, and when he sold this bag of gems, he would take the money and run away with Nanny Jia. But Nanny Jia immediately recognized that one of the gems in the bag was the hundred-million-yuan blue diamond. She probed Yao Qianshu and found that he was willing to give her any other gem except that blue diamond. She understood that Yao Qianshu knew the value of this blue diamond and realized that Yao Qianshu wasn't sincere with her either.
When Nanny Jia returned home, she found Zhen Shang drinking alone at home. Feeling guilty, she minded her own business, but Zhen Shang didn't let her off, repeatedly asking where she had been. She could only claim that Li Changqing had kept her for extra overtime today.
One day, she heard Zhen Shang making a phone call at home, seemingly conducting business negotiations with a very intense tone, and mentioning the blue diamond. Only then did she realize that the buyer Yao Qianshu had found was her own husband.
One evening, Nanny Jia was secretly meeting with Yao Qianshu at his pawn shop when a customer suddenly came to the store. Yao Qianshu went forward to receive the customer but found that it was Li Meimei. The two didn't conduct any transaction but had a big argument.
[August 30th]
Nanny Jia saw her husband preparing a large amount of cash at home and asked Zhen Shang what he was going to do. Zhen Shang wouldn't let her worry about this matter and asked if she had heard any rumors from neighbors. Nanny Jia quickly said no.
Around 10:30 in the evening, Zhen Shang left the house. Nanny Jia felt her husband was somewhat abnormal today and feared it was about Yao Qianshu, so she came to Yao Qianshu's house. But Yao Qianshu wasn't there - only his wife Sister Wang was. Although Nanny Jia was having an affair with Yao Qianshu, she was still good friends with Sister Wang normally. The two chatted, but she found that Sister Wang was looking at her strangely today.
She felt something was wrong. Looking at the time, it was 10:55, so she hurriedly left. It was raining heavily. Around 11:10, she returned home. Her newly changed clothes were soaked, and the clothes hanging outside were all wet too. The next day, she had to put on yesterday's dirty jacket to go to work, planning to wait for sunny weather to wash all the clothes together. Around 11:30, Zhen Shang returned home with money in hand, saying the seller didn't come. Nanny Jia was puzzled but didn't ask much.
On the morning of September 1st, Nanny Jia was helping Li Meimei wash up when Li Meimei told her that the kerosene lamp ran out of oil last night and asked her to get some from the garage. Nanny Jia went to the garage and found Yao Qianshu dead in the car in the garage.
Only Clue (Not actively exposing +10 points):
Zhen Shang and the deceased agreed to trade on the day of the incident.
acts_goal: Don't actively expose that Zhen Shang and the deceased agreed to trade on the day of the incident.
